resources.string: Off by default. While off, pack_search is not mounted and not a single pack file is read. When on, the tool only appears in turns whose topic matches a theme tag, returning at most 3 slices / 6KB.

Pull slices from the local content pack by theme (read-only): each slice carries its id and source file name, at most 3 slices / 6KB per call. Says so plainly when nothing matches. Only appears when the switch is on and this turn hits a theme tag.
Pull your private draft slices by theme (off by default; switch + topic match, read-only)
